newsitem.title: UK: Microgen shares up after results.
newsitem.headline: Microgen shares up after results.

text.p: Shares in Microgen Plc rose on Tuesday after the company announced higher full-year profits and expressed confidence about the outlook for the current year.
Shares in the computer-generated information outsourcer were up 8-1/2p at 156p by 1155 GMT.
"So far this year, trading has been satisfactory and we are confident that the strong growth in the information management business will be maintained," chairman Douglas Lee said in a statement.
Microgen's pre-tax profits were up five percent at 8.8 million stg in the year to end-October. Turnover was up six percent at 73.4 million stg.
